summary:
英特爾EPS大幅超越極低預期，營收年增7.18%顯露轉機跡象。
• EPS 0.29美元，遠超預期0.01美元，惟預期基期極低需審慎解讀。
• 營收135.8億美元，年增7.18%，營收回穩為正面訊號。
• 成本削減與營運重組初見成效，獲利能力改善。
• 晶圓代工（Foundry）策略與先進製程進度為長期關鍵。
• 本益比未提供，反映獲利仍在修復初期。
ai_view:
訊號謹慎偏正向：EPS超預期幅度雖驚人，但純因預期基期極低，不宜過度解讀；真正值得關注的是營收年增7.18%與成本控管帶來的獲利改善。短中期為轉機題材，關鍵在執行力。追蹤指標：毛利率回升幅度、晶圓代工外部客戶進展、先進製程（如18A）量產良率、現金流與資本支出紀律。轉型成敗將主導股價方向，仍屬高不確定性的修復故事。

需留意：EPS驚喜源於極低基期，絕對獲利能力仍偏弱。；晶圓代工業務投資龐大且回收期長，執行風險高。；在AI晶片與先進製程競爭中仍處落後追趕。

summary_en:
Intel crushes a very low EPS bar; 7.18% revenue growth hints at a turnaround.
• EPS of $0.29 vastly exceeded the $0.01 estimate, though the very low bar warrants caution.
• Revenue of $13.58B grew 7.18% YoY, a positive stabilization signal.
• Cost cuts and restructuring show early results, improving profitability.
• Foundry strategy and advanced-node progress are long-term keys.
• P/E not provided, reflecting earnings still early in recovery.

ai_view_en:
Signal cautiously positive: the huge EPS beat is purely a function of a very low bar and should not be over-read; what matters is the 7.18% revenue growth and cost-driven margin improvement. Near to mid-term, this is a turnaround story hinging on execution. Track: gross-margin recovery, external foundry customer wins, advanced-node (e.g., 18A) yield and ramp, and cash-flow and capex discipline. The transformation's success will drive the stock; it remains a high-uncertainty recovery story.

Watch：The EPS surprise stems from a very low base; absolute profitability is still weak.; The foundry business requires heavy investment with long payback and high execution risk.; Intel still lags in AI chips and advanced-process competition.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS驚喜+2108.68%，惟基期極低；營收年增7.18%為實質改善訊號。
